body.x: Daegu TP Sports Convergence Industrial Support Center will participate in CES 2018 (Consumer Electronics Show), the world's largest IT appliance exhibition in Las Vegas, USA from Jan. 9th (Tue) to 12th (Fri) and operate a joint booth of 13 companies regarding sports convergence industrial technology.

Daegu Techno Park (Hereinafter referred to as, Daegu TP) Sports Convergence Industrial Support Center was established in May 2015 with the support of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and Daegu City, for the development of sports in Daegu and Gyeongbuk area. In order to enter the US market, they participate in the Sports & Fitness Tech Zone with 13 regional companies by creating a joint booth for the first time in Korea.

In the Sports Convergence Industrial Support Center joint booth, technology and product exhibits, product demonstrations, as well as export consultations with related buyers in the US and around the world will be taken place. Regarding sports ICT convergence technology, ▲Seesun Co., Ltd. has developed Smart Sunglasses <B:CON> which combines sunglasses, bone conduction oscillator speaker and Bluetooth based ICT technology. ▲Rootech Co., Ltd presents an electric bicycle kit that is easy to install and can be controlled by a smart phone.

▲Onesoftdigm Co., Ltd displays <One smart diet>, a portable body composition analyzer and activity meter that is smaller than a finger and <FitRus>, a body composition-based healthcare platform service. ▲202BPM Co., Ltd has launched an ICT home training platform that works with smart phone apps in CES 2017. In this year, in CES 2018, newly developed game contents will be introduced to make exercise easier and more enjoyable. ▲Sillasystem Co., Ltd first presents <Smart cooling glove> based on IoT to help control body temperature during sport activities through the management and analysis of bio information. ▲Atdlab Co., Ltd introduces <Powergenic>, a rugby scrum machine that can measure the athletic performance of rugby players and manage them in smart devices.

The exhibition of the virtual reality (VR) field which is getting the most attention recently is also realized. ▲Show-Indoor-Sports demonstrates a VR simulator and contents with which users perform real physical activities to play sports games such as cycling and bob-sleigh. ▲EC3 Co., Ltd plans to introduce an indoor cycle training device, ‘Bitelli.’

▲<Skiate> of Skiate Co. that combines skiing and skating and Seyoung Co., Ltd’s two-way radio transceiver aim to continue their success in 2017. These products are expected to draw much attention from buyers. In addition, the heating mat and pad using carbon fiber heating modules of ▲GUMIC Co., Ltd, the stretch good <Coolpin> of ▲YHLife Co., Ltd, and the carbon composite bicycle frame of TforL Co., Ltd participate in the joint booth to enter overseas markets.

Daegu TP Sports Convergence Industrial Support Center is going to hold a networking party with various events on Jan. 10, the second day of exhibition, and invite foreign buyers and people in media in order to help the 13 participating companies get attention. “Hopefully, this joint booth will be good opportunities for local companies to enter global markets,” said Lee Jae-Hoon, the director of Daegu TP Sports Convergence Industrial Support Center, who has organized the management of the joint booth in CES 2018, Las Vegas. “We will do our best to support the local IT companies which have the most advanced technology in the country.”

CES, the world's largest IT trade show, is sponsored by the American Consumer Electronics Association (CTA) and held every January to provide the outline of the global consumer electronics industry. Have reported issues in the world's top three tech shows (CES, MWC and IFA), Global News Network Aving News will also send a special reporting team to CES this year to broadcast key issues in the global market and introduce major Korean companies to the world.
